Name: Phone Owner
Description: Name of the person who owns the primary phone; often a family member, not the patient

Name: Phone Owner Relationship
Description: Relationship of the phone owner to the patient (Mother, Father, Patient / Self, ...)

Name: WhatsApp Available
Description: Whether the primary phone can receive WhatsApp messages

Name: Telegram Available
Description: Whether the primary phone can receive Telegram messages

Name: Consent Person
Description: Person who gave consent, if not the patient

Name: School
Description: School attended, where the patient is a child
